name: 1. Detection
requirement: LOVO recall 22/22, FP on clean ≤ 1 (catch-all adds ≤ 1)
detail: LOVO TP=17/22, FP=2; rule design used this dataset

name: 2. Localization
requirement: ≥ 80 % within ±2 s, ≥ 95 % within ±5 s; 1–3 valid JPEGs, one within ±1 s

name: 3. Classification
requirement: type_id + rule card on every violation; LOVO type accuracy ≥ 80 %

name: 4. Grounding
requirement: every citation in kb/rule_cards.json, quotes verbatim (tests), SOURCES.md honest
detail: full unit test artifact includes verbatim KB quotation checks

name: 5. Robustness
requirement: verdict agreement ≥ 90 %, timecode within ±3 s ≥ 80 %, roles on flips/rotations

name: 6. Time
requirement: ≤ 240 s on the longest video; watchdog returns before 300 s
detail: cold timing and actually exercised slow-inference watchdog; hard process timeout tested separately

name: 7. Offline & local
requirement: HF offline + socket guard run succeeds; audit: no outbound calls, no face models
detail: full perception/VLM path with socket guard; see offline_report.json

name: 8. Contract
detail: real HTTP lifecycle plus package/CLI evidence equality

name: 9. Reproducibility
requirement: fresh clone → README steps → setup/test/eval succeed; Docker build + api-test
detail: isolated wheel resources=True; Docker unavailable, fresh dependency installation not verified

name: 10. Docs
requirement: all documents exist and are current; FINAL_REPORT has metrics, hardware, per-video, failures, commands
detail: see narrative for unmet gates and exact reproduction commands
